title: Handling of serving PLMN rate control

entities.name: Serving PLMN rate control
entities.description: A mechanism enabling the serving PLMN to protect its MME and signalling radio bearers from load generated by NAS messages with user data over control plane. The MME informs the UE of local serving PLMN rate control during default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Procedure during which the MME can inform the UE of any local serving PLMN rate control.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Serving PLMN rate control is applicable only for PDN connections established for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: First NAS message with user data over control plane
entities.description: Trigger condition for MME to start serving PLMN rate control for the PDN connection.

entities.name: UE limits uplink NAS message rate
entities.description: The UE shall limit the rate at which it generates uplink NAS messages with user data over control plane to comply with the serving PLMN policy.

entities.name: Rate valid until PDN connection release
entities.description: The indicated rate in a NAS procedure applies to the corresponding PDN connection and is valid until the PDN connection is released.

entities.name: Discard serving PLMN rate control information
entities.description: Serving PLMN rate control information shall be discarded when the UE successfully registers to another PLMN.

relations.description: MME can inform UE of serving PLMN rate control during default EPS bearer context activation.
MME starts serving PLMN rate control when the first NAS message with user data over control plane is received.
Serving PLMN rate control is applicable only for PDN connections established for control plane CIoT EPS optimization.
UE shall limit uplink NAS message rate with user data over control plane to comply with serving PLMN policy.
Indicated rate applies to the PDN connection and is valid until PDN connection release.
Serving PLMN rate control information is discarded when UE registers to another PLMN.
